Raptors are bringing Jamarion Sharp into camp.

Sharp had been with them for Summer League before signing a 2-way with Clippers; Raps had 2-way interest at the time. He’ll compete for one of those spots now.

7-foot-5 centre was 25-26 G League Defensive Player of the Year.
